# AI Note Reformat Prompt

Copy this prompt with your notes into an AI assistant.

```text
Please reformat my language-learning notes for Lang Reader.

Rules:
- Keep the content compact.
- Use Markdown headings for sections.
- Use [translation] for translations.
- In Reader, use {note} for inline notes and > for note-only lines; both are visible but not spoken.
- In either mode, use fenced text blocks for visible instructions that should not be read aloud.
- For vocabulary, prefer: word [translation] -> example sentence.
- Keep useful original numbering.
- Do not add explanations outside the converted notes.
```
